content.short: Ondo Finance is a leading DeFi protocol providing institutional-grade access to tokenized real-world assets.
content.description: Ondo Finance is a pioneering decentralized finance protocol that bridges the gap between institutional-grade financial products and the digital asset ecosystem. By enabling the tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs) such as US Treasuries and corporate bonds, Ondo allows users to gain exposure to low-risk, yield-bearing traditional assets within a decentralized environment. The protocol focuses on regulatory compliance, transparency, and high capital efficiency, providing a robust framework for investors to diversify their on-chain portfolios. As a critical infrastructure provider for the RWA sector, Ondo Finance drives the integration of global capital markets with the innovations of Web3, fostering a more resilient and professional digital asset landscape.
content.meta: Ondo Finance provides institutional-grade tokenized real-world assets, enabling secure access to DeFi liquidity and traditional yields for global users.

resources.title: Tokenized Stocks Backed by DTC Entitlements
resources.tldr: The first tokens backed by entitlements to securities held at the central depository. Unglamorous plumbing, and the part that makes the rest legally real.

resources.title: FINRA Authorizations for Tokenized Equities and Funds
resources.tldr: Regulatory permission to run markets in tokenised securities for US investors. The licence is the hard part; the technology has existed for years.

resources.title: Bringing Japanese Equities On-Chain
resources.tldr: A partnership with one of Japan's largest financial groups. Short, and notable because each new jurisdiction brings its own settlement and custody regime.
